text: Wow, this is bad: Email or Google for sign up, but Google doesn't work. If you did go through the huddle with putting your email, you immediately need to get a subscription - there is a free trial of 3 days, but only with the subscription and you can't check out any content of the app before subscribing. A big no go for me!
author: Cos Ce

text: Es gibt keine Free Version. Um es zu benutzen muss man ein Abo abschließen. Dafür das die App für Menschen mit ADHS ist, ziemlich mies. Grad wir vergessen sowas doch immer zu kündigen...
author: Alexander S.
developer_reply: Hi Alexander! There is a 3 day free trial, so you can see if you like it! If you choose to continue, we've aimed to price our app as economically as possible without impacting user's experience with distracting ads.
